subject: No Snow!
author: ZombieTron
body:
Xandu took the pics, we just drove up to have a look. The last time I was here the ski centre had just closed as it was May, so it was nice to see people enjoying the slopes. It was really cold and we weren't dressed for the snow really so we stopped at the ski centre cafe for a hot chocolate and will have to go back next year to ski. I haven't been for many, many years, but would love to ski again! They had some rails set up for boarders too!! 😃

--- The Original and the Best ---
